items.text: ETR Sunday injury board: OUT includes Barkley, Smith, Lamar, Hall, Diggs, Johnston, Pittman, Bryant (IR), Charbonnet, others. IN: Daniels, Olave, Love, Goedert. Q: Chase/Higgins, Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, McConkey, Flowers, Stevenson, McLaurin, Kamara, etc.
items.implication: Messy slate with many Qs bracing for Sunday AM updates.
items.opportunity: Parse beneficiaries for OUTs (e.g. Love clear, Goedert back).

items.text: Eagles officially ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) for Sunday’s London game vs. Jaguars.
items.why: Hamstring injuries; missed practice all week.
items.implication: Eagles backfield and WR corps depleted; elevates backups and Goedert.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining RBs; more targets to Goedert/Wicks.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will start Sunday vs. Giants; WR Stefon Diggs out with hamstring.
items.implication: Daniels full go; Diggs absence boosts other WRs/TEs.
items.opportunity: More targets to McLaurin (Q) or others.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson ruled out for Sunday night vs. Falcons with left ankle injury; Tyler Huntley to start. Also out: Trey Hendrickson, Cam Jurgens.
items.why: Ankle sprain from Week 4; missed all practice.
items.implication: Limits Ravens passing upside; Huntley start caps Flowers/Andrews.
items.opportunity: Reduced efficiency for Zay Flowers and Mark Andrews.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) for Sunday vs. Browns.
items.implication: Opens Jets RB work for backups.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining Jets RBs.

items.text: Broncos placed WR Pat Bryant on injured reserve (ankle); promoted Lil’Jordan Humphrey.
items.why: Ankle sprain from prior game; short-term IR.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans is off the injury report and has no injury designation for Sunday at Seattle. Also out: Kyle Juszczyk, Nick Bosa.

Jeremiyah Love (ankle maintenance, limited practice but full-go comments, not on final IR) projected with much bigger workload than Week 4; 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier currently. Gut says much better role but account for downside.
items.why: Not on final report; media/fan drag on prior usage may spur more work; ankle maintenance only.
items.implication: Strong RB projection lead; startable with upside.
items.opportunity: Expanded carries/snaps vs. prior week; goal-line potential.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston, OT Joe Alt and S Derwin James among others.
items.implication: Ladd McConkey (also Q) or others see more targets.
items.opportunity: Potential target bump for McConkey if he plays.

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift has no injury designation (hip/knee) for Sunday at GB; Kyle Monangai ruled out.
items.why: No designation after missed practice time.
items.implication: Swift full workload expected; Monangai out.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red zone vs. soft Titans defense.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload and soft run defense, potential boost from Bengals WR injuries.

Malik Nabers multi-factor long-term risks: knee becoming real issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy under center, coaching staff (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) boomer tendencies. Frustration over limited second-half targets noted.
items.why: Sore knee (missed practice), shoulder history, QB/coaching uncertainty, target frustration.
items.implication: Caution on ROS value despite talent.

items.text: Hates Jalen Hurts vs. JAX (QB15) due to rough stretch/banged-up line; hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41) on tough matchup/injury wrinkle/thin role; also hates Andrews, Skattebo, Pollard.
